facts.fact: Law 12/26, approved on 31 July 2026 and promulgated on 7 September 2026, authorises the President to legislate on electronic signatures, digital certification and Angola's public key infrastructure (ICP-AO) with an accrediting authority and a root certification entity.
facts.system: Infra-Estrutura de Chaves Públicas de Angola (ICP-AO)

AGO.note: Security duties for certification entities are only an authorised head of power, no body or response stated.
Nothing on a data protection law or authority.
The law is an authorisation on e-signatures and certification, not an e-commerce law.
Geographic redundancy is only a requirement for certification entities the decree may set, no backup site stated.
